name: Psychic Programmer [Psionic]
body:
Machines are no less vulnerable than minds if one knows how to properly exploit them.

Prerequisite(s): Manifester level 9th

Benefit(s): You may ignore the immunity of constructs to mind-affecting effects. This does not prevent your mind-affecting powers from being susceptible to power resistance.
